# PROMOTION CEREMONY
\n
[bold][color=yellow]--->[/bold][/color]
\n
A special procedure done usually out of sector with the proper equipment. Select [bold][color=yellow]Initiates[/bold][/color] who show exemplary performance with the corporation are picked by the [bold][color=yellow]Seraph[/bold][/color] to be personally converted into full employees.
This comes with the full transition of their species into either a [bold]lizard[/bold] or a [bold]hydrakin[/bold]. The employee's old body is stripped and discarded, a new name and identity is given, and they are officially inducted into the corporate's ranks as a full-time asset. The promotion is kept a secret to other initiates, but it is as much of an open secret to proper ranks as it is a closed secret to the grunt fodder.
> [color=red]It is also one of the reasons why you will NEVER see a non hydrakin or lizard in any rank higher than an initiates.[/color]
